topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a post online, a close-up of someone's arm, my design inked into their skin. My heart thuds, a rapid beat I can't control. It’s a strange sight, seeing my work, something I poured hours into, now permanent on a stranger. I don’t know how to feel—honored, perhaps, but there’s a tightness in my chest. The internet is a vast, unpredictable place. My creations are out there, beyond my reach, bearing the touch of someone else’s hands, someone else’s choice. I keep thinking, what if they don’t understand the meaning, the layers, the intention behind it? What if it gets lost in the translation of needle to skin?
